messages:
carter: Quick sync — proposing a soft unpin of runtime v2.16 for the llama3q family in the 02:00 UTC change window tonight. We think the runtime perf regression is contained but it blocks a few model variants. Need compatibility sign-off + rollback plan.

tessa: +1 for soft unpin if we have a clear fallback. Do we have test coverage for long-context KV cache w/ 2.17?

raj: Ran the canary tests earlier — memory + kvcache look fine on 2.17, but we saw ~3% latency variance at 512 tokens on A100s. Not catastrophic but worth noting.

maria: Can you paste the failing model IDs? I want to check eval diffs.

carter: Failing variants: llama3q-13b-v1, llama3q-7b-hr. Fail mode is tokenization mismatch in ~0.2% of eval prompts, and sometimes a truncated final token.

sam: I ran the prompt-set against 2.17 nightly. Most diffs are whitespace or trailing token artifacts. I pushed a small temp shim in the SDK that normalizes trailing bytes — PR #4521 — this fixes 95% of cases.

kevin: Important: if we unpin runtime at 02:00 UTC, deploybot needs an explicit rollback workflow to 2.16 that preserves model pins. Otherwise, customers on Dedicated may see behavior change.

carter: Agreed. Proposal: soft unpin on hosted (auto-route to 2.17), but keep Dedicated/runtime-pinned customers pinned until we finish a stability pass. Rollback steps below. Thoughts?

raj: That sounds reasonable. For hosted: route policy = preference: [2.17, 2.16] so requests prefer 2.17 but can fallback. For Dedicated: no change. I've drafted the change config.

deploybot: [deploybot] change-plan created: cp-2012309876-soft-unpin-hosted. Window: 2026-03-20 02:00:00 UTC. Targets: hosted runtime routing policy.

maria: I reviewed eval diffs after sam's SDK shim. Remaining diffs are non-semantic in 0.05% of prompts. Good to proceed for hosted.

sam: Can we gate unpin with a post-deploy smoke test? Quick script:

```
# smoke: ensure kv-cache + trailing-token normalized
curl -sS -X POST "$REDWOOD_API/generate" -d '{"model":"llama3q-13b-v1","prompt":"<smoke prompt>","max_tokens":64}' | jq '.text' | grep -q "<expected suffix>"
```

kevin: Add a rollback job that flips routing to hard-pin 2.16 for the flagged model list and re-deploys canary routing. Keep a 30min observation window.

carter: OK final plan: 1) At 02:00 UTC deploybot applies routing policy cp-2012309876-soft-unpin-hosted. 2) Run smoke script x5 across regions (eu/west/us). 3) If any smoke fails, rollback job rb-2012309876 flips to hard-pin 2.16 for flagged models and pauses unpin. 4) Notify customers impacted.

deploybot: [deploybot] Scheduled: cp-2012309876-soft-unpin-hosted -> queued for 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z. Preflight checks: config lint OK, gating script present.

tessa: Thx — I'm standing by for the smoke runs. If they pass I'll ack in 15m.

(02:01 UTC) deploybot: [deploybot] cp-2012309876-soft-unpin-hosted applied to hosted routing.

(02:03 UTC) sam: smoke run eu-west: PASS x5.

(02:04 UTC) raj: us-west smoke: PASS x5.

(02:06 UTC) maria: eu-central smoke: PASS x5. All metrics within baseline. No regression alerts.

(02:10 UTC) carter: We're green. Proceeding to mark the change as complete and notifying support to send the customer note for Dedicated exceptions. :tada:

deploybot: [deploybot] Change cp-2012309876 completed. audit-id: audit-2012309876. If rollback needed run rb-2012309876 within next 60m.

kevin: Noted. I'll keep rb-2012309876 ready, but we won't execute unless support flags a problem. Great job.

(03:44 UTC) carter: Post-mortem note: tracked minor tokenization drift fixed with SDK shim. We'll schedule a follow-up to roll the shim into the stable SDK and add a unit test for trailing-token normalization.
